name: 83716 · Boise, ID
findings: ZIP 83716 (Boise) has 63 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 83716 (Boise) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 83716 (Boise) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).
